title: Clicking Constellation Cuttlefish
statement: Hovering amidst swaying ribbon kelp in warm, twilight-blue water, this pocket-sized cuttlefish carefully sorts bits of frosted sea glass and smooth pebbles into neat spirals along terraced slate shelves. Whenever it finishes a pleasing arrangement, it lets out a gentle, rhythmic clicking and ripples tiny star-map constellations across its velvety skin.
